headline: Maui County Liquor Control Commission

meeting.summary: Roy's Limited Partnership No. 2 asked to allow drinking in set areas of its golf courses.
meeting.recap: Roy's Limited Partnership No. 2 asked to allow drinking in set areas of its golf courses.[[0:04:51]] The applicant said it stopped selling alcohol on the golf course on June 15, 2022.[[0:12:51]] The commission voted to let the application move forward without the 500-foot notice.[[0:31:47]] The commission approved application 04, a restaurant liquor license, at a preliminary hearing.[[0:40:47]] The commission approved application 07, a dispenser general liquor license for Saigon Palace.[[0:53:06]] The director said this year's state liquor conference covered Maui's recovery after the August 8 wildfires.[[0:56:51]] Commissioners agreed the director may add a list of his wildfire recovery work to his goals report.[[1:22:25]] The commission approved a renewed emergency rule on relocation liquor license applications.[[1:44:38]] The commission approved updated wording on its form for registering minors for employment.[[1:46:45]] Commissioners set December 3rd or earlier as the due date for their director reviews.[[1:48:24]] The commission accepted an email complaint and sent it to the enforcement division for review.[[1:49:46]] The commission met in executive session (a closed-door discussion) with its attorney on three files.[[1:52:50]] The commission voted to close file 2023-01.[[1:54:22]]
decided: The commission approved the day's agenda.
The commission approved the minutes of its October 9, 2024 meeting.
The commission confirmed general licensing matters A through F.
The commission let Roy's Limited Partnership No. 2 move forward with its golf course application without the 500-foot radius notice.
The commission approved application 04 for a restaurant general liquor license at its preliminary hearing.
Commissioners had no objection to the director adding a list of his wildfire recovery work to his goals report.
The commission approved the renewed emergency rule on relocation liquor license applications.
The commission voted to close file 2023-01.
meeting.next: The golf course permit will be processed. Starting next year, the state liquor workshop and conference are expected to be held separately. The director will provide an addendum listing his wildfire recovery work. Staff will send commissioners an online survey form for their director reviews once it is checked. The vice chair will compile the commissioners' individual reviews of the director. The email complaint is going to the enforcement division for further review.
